summary: The registrant, High Templar Tech Ltd, filed a Form 6-K disclosing the commencement of a tender offer to repurchase up to 39 million of its ADSs. The press release incorporated by reference to the Schedule TO-I filed on May 26, 2026, details the issuer self-tender. The company is repurchasing its own shares from public shareholders, with the board's recommendation and advisor details to be found in the Schedule TO. The offer reduces outstanding float and signals capital allocation. The tender is open for a specified period under SEC Rule 13e-4, subject to proration if oversubscribed. Watch for the final acceptance and settlement, which will impact remaining holders' pro-rata entitlement.
